message.content:
Wool-blend blazer in soft camel (#C6A882), structured shoulder cut, mid-length hemline, warm-toned fabric.  
Silk-cotton blouse in muted olive (#6B7F6D), relaxed fit, knee-length hemline, lightweight woven material.  
Wide-leg trousers in charcoal grey (#4F5053), tapered ankle, full-length leg opening, soft ponte knit fabric.  
Leather loafers in deep brown (#5D4037), pointed toe, mid-height block heel, smooth calf leather material.  
Gold-plated pendant necklace and minimalist hoop earrings to complement her warm skin tones (#deb295).  
This outfit balances the office creative environment with a polished yet approachable neat aesthetic suitable for autumn weather. The camel grey palette harmonizes naturally with her complexion while the structured blazer adds professional weight without sacrificing comfort. Textured fabrics like wool and ponte ensure warmth as temperatures drop, while the relaxed blouse cuts provide breathability for indoor office settings.
